read.thesis: Prologis Q1 CY26: record 64M sq ft leasing, same-store cash NOI +8.8%, and development starts raised to $4.5-5.5B (about 40% data centres) even as leasing spreads slowed to 32%.

utilisation.quote: We ended the quarter with occupancy of 95.3%, reflecting the seasonal drop we telegraphed

capex.quote: we are increasing development starts to $4.5 billion to $5.5 billion on an owned and managed basis

triggers.label: Occupancy 95.3%, FY outlook raised
triggers.quote: we are increasing our forecast for average occupancy to a range of 95% to 95.75%

triggers.label: Market rents up first time in 2.5 years
U.S. construction pipeline 1.7% of stock
triggers.quote: the construction pipeline remains favorable at just 1.7% of stock compared to a 10-year average of 2.6%

triggers.label: Net effective rent change slowed to 32%
triggers.quote: Net effective rent change was more muted this quarter at 32%, driven primarily by market mix.

guidance.quote: we are increasing our forecast for average occupancy to a range of 95% to 95.75%
expectations for net effective same-store growth to 4.5% to 5.5% and cash growth to 6.25% to 7%
we are increasing development starts to $4.5 billion to $5.5 billion on an owned and managed basis
while core FFO, excluding the promote expense, will range between $6.12 and $6.28 per share
Our expectation for full-year rent change to approach 40% on a net effective basis remains unchanged.

red_flags.label: Leasing spreads decelerating
red_flags.quote: Net effective rent change was more muted this quarter at 32%, driven primarily by market mix.

red_flags.label: Q1 bad debt unusually low, flattering NOI
red_flags.quote: the period also benefited from unusually low bad debt

evasions.quote: In terms of balancing around occupancy and rent change, it is really not only market by market, it is really deal by deal.
